5: function debugLog(message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown>) {
6:   try {
7:     const suffix = details ? ` ${JSON.stringify(details)}` : ""
8:     require("node:fs").appendFileSync(DEBUG_LOG_PATH, `[${new Date().toISOString()}] [REVIEW_TRANSPORT] ${message}${suffix}\n`, "utf8")
9:   } catch {}
10: }

12: const REVIEW_AGENTS = new Set(["review-risk", "review-resilience", "review-readability", "review-reliability", "review-refuter", "review-validator"])
13: const TRANSPORT = {
14:   Command: "gentle-ai",
15:   Schema: "gentle-ai.provider-transport/v1",
16:   Start: "start",
17:   Prompt: "prompt",
18:   Complete: "complete",
19:   Result: "result",
20: } as const

22: interface TransportFrame {
23:   schema: string
24:   operation: string
25:   nonce?: string
26:   prompt?: string
27:   output?: string
28:   error?: string
29: }
30: 
31: interface Relay {
32:   prompt: Promise<{ nonce: string; prompt: string }>
33:   complete: (output: unknown) => Promise<string>
34:   close: () => void
35: }
36: 
37: interface RelayRegistration {
38:   owner: symbol

47:   if (runtime[RELAY_REGISTRY_KEY] === undefined) runtime[RELAY_REGISTRY_KEY] = new Map<string, RelayRegistration>()

64:     `You have no review binding and no frozen candidate evidence. Do not inspect anything, ` +
65:     `do not fabricate findings, and do not return a review result. ` +
66:     `Reply with exactly: ${RELAY_REFUSED_CODE}`

80: function startRelay(cwd: string, prompt: string): Relay {
81:   debugLog("starting Go review relay", { cwd, promptLength: prompt.length })
82:   const child = spawn(TRANSPORT.Command, ["review", "opencode-transport"], { cwd, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] })
83:   let buffered = ""
84:   let closed = false
85:   const stderr: Buffer[] = []
86:   let resolvePrompt: (value: { nonce: string; prompt: string }) => void
87:   let rejectPrompt: (reason: unknown) => void
88:   let resolveResult: (value: string) => void
89:   let rejectResult: (reason: unknown) => void
90:   const promptFrame = new Promise<{ nonce: string; prompt: string }>((resolve, reject) => { resolvePrompt = resolve; rejectPrompt = reject })
91:   const resultFrame = new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => { resolveResult = resolve; rejectResult = reject })
92:   void promptFrame.catch(() => {})
93:   void resultFrame.catch(() => {})
94:   const fail = (cause: unknown) => {
95:     if (closed) return

97:     debugLog("relay failed", { error: String(cause) })
98:     rejectPrompt(cause)
99:     rejectResult(cause)
100:   }

102:     buffered += chunk.toString("utf8")
103:     for (;;) {
104:       const newline = buffered.indexOf("\n")

106:       const line = buffered.slice(0, newline)
107:       buffered = buffered.slice(newline + 1)
108:       try {
109:         const frame = decodeTransportFrame(line)
110:         debugLog("relay frame received", { operation: frame.operation, hasNonce: !!frame.nonce, outputLength: frame.output?.length ?? 0 })

112:         if (frame.operation === TRANSPORT.Prompt && typeof frame.nonce === "string" && frame.nonce !== "" && typeof frame.prompt === "string" && frame.prompt !== "") {

116:         if (frame.operation === TRANSPORT.Result && typeof frame.output === "string" && frame.output !== "") {
117:           closed = true
118:           resolveResult(frame.output)
119:           continue
120:         }
121:         throw new Error("invalid Go relay frame")
122:       } catch (cause) {
123:         fail(cause)
124:       }
125:     }
126:   })
127:   child.stdin.on("error", fail)
128:   child.on("error", fail)
129:   child.stderr.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => stderr.push(chunk))
130:   child.on("close", (code) => {
131:     debugLog("relay process closed", { code })
132:     if (!closed) fail(new Error(Buffer.concat(stderr).toString("utf8").trim() || `Go review relay exited before completion (${code ?? "signal"})`))
133:   })
134:   child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ schema: TRANSPORT.Schema, operation: TRANSPORT.Start, prompt }) + "\n", (cause) => {
135:     if (cause) fail(cause)
136:   })
137:   return {
138:     prompt: promptFrame,
139:     complete: async (output: unknown) => {
140:       const materialized = await promptFrame
141:       debugLog("completing relay", { nonce: materialized.nonce, outputType: typeof output, outputLength: typeof output === "string" ? output.length : undefined })
142:       const completion: TransportFrame = { schema: TRANSPORT.Schema, operation: TRANSPORT.Complete, nonce: materialized.nonce }
143:       if (typeof output === "string") completion.output = output
144:       else completion.error = "opencode_task_host_output_unavailable"
145:       child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(completion) + "\n")
146:       return resultFrame
147:     },

149:       debugLog("closing relay")
150:       if (!closed) closed = true
151:       if (!child.killed) child.kill()
152:     },
153:   }

156: const OpenCodeReviewTransportPlugin: Plugin = async ({ directory, worktree }) => {
157:   const owner = Symbol("gentle-ai-opencode-review-transport")
158:   const relays = reviewRelayRegistry()
159:   const deferred = new Map<string, RelayRegistration>()
160:   const refused = new Map<string, string>()
161:   const cwd = () => worktree || directory
162:   debugLog("plugin initialized", { directory, worktree, registrySize: relays.size })
163:   const clearOwned = (key: string) => {
164:     const registration = relays.get(key)
165:     if (!registration || registration.owner !== owner) return
166:     debugLog("clearing owned relay", { key })
167:     relays.delete(key)
168:     registration.relay.close()
169:   }
170:   const clearSession = (prefix: string) => {
171:     for (const [key, registration] of relays) {
172:       if (!key.startsWith(prefix) || registration.owner !== owner) continue
173:       debugLog("clearing relay for deleted session", { key })
174:       relays.delete(key)
175:       registration.relay.close()
176:     }
177:     for (const key of deferred.keys()) if (key.startsWith(prefix)) deferred.delete(key)
178:     for (const key of refused.keys()) if (key.startsWith(prefix)) refused.delete(key)
179:   }
180:   return {
181:     dispose: async () => {
182:       debugLog("plugin dispose", { ownedRelays: [...relays.values()].filter((r) => r.owner === owner).length })
183:       deferred.clear()
184:       refused.clear()
185:       for (const [key, registration] of relays) if (registration.owner === owner) clearOwned(key)
186:     },
187:     event: async ({ event }) => {
188:       if (event.type !== "session.deleted") return
189:       debugLog("session.deleted", { sessionID: event.properties.info.id })
190:       const prefix = `${event.properties.info.id}:`
191:       clearSession(prefix)
192:     },
